# Positive unary-cycle clock for a fixed finite data background

**Current source status:** conditional analytic source accepted without mathematical repair under `UNARY_CYCLE_CLOCK_ROOT_ACCEPTANCE.json`, SHA `4dd58d6860a2a2a0e73930ea2298210059a4f99e52d569846735ba3bc4cf1d07`. Root accepted source assembly e8edba3c under UNARY_CYCLE_CLOCK_ASSEMBLY_ROOT_ACCEPTANCE.json SHA7d5c9129de3453b6c478e3f974bb6846d7328bac55578ed2483c86fccf103670 and review2e628762619b4838857b574ca9197fa95e1434479aeb5c3dff4ea0550b96ac6a. This publication rendering and driver require separate exact root acceptance; no retained audit or native physical realization is supplied.

Can a finite physical qubit clock reproduce a supplied control waveform while the original data Hamiltonian remains present? The accepted proof uses positive nearest-neighbor bonds on a cycle of L additional qubits, a specified independent coherent one-excitation packet, and sampled clock–data program terms. For arbitrary finite Hermitian H, including its scalar and noncommuting controls, it bounds the full prepared isometry against the actual freely evolving clock tensor the chronological data evolution. Tensoring with any passive reference preserves the bound.

The proof charges positive smoothing, packet width, two separate Dyson cutoff comparisons, sine-versus-linear dispersion and the additional comparison to the actual free clock. The ordinary compression requires the strict guard `L>2B+R`; equality can alias. The sufficient parameters are finite and effective under the stated computable-data and certified-tolerance premises. The physical duration T includes every inherited recurrence wait. The scalar `1/a` in the clock restriction and every scalar in H remain in the phase and energy ledger.

Clock-clock locality is specific: the actual closing bond and all other cycle bonds are ordinary nearest neighbor. The program terms have support at most three sites but growing clock–data range. Clock-site strength is at most `2/a+c`; data-site incidence is bounded by `ell+c t_i/a`. L physical clock qubits, coherent preparation, calibration, observation timing and terminal readout are paid or supplied as stated. No common fixed strength is obtained as accuracy improves. The optional addressed preparation circuit separately assumes clean vacuum, an external clock, arbitrary supported generators and removal or exact compensation of preparation drift, with data admitted at the declared stage.

The free clock is positive on all clock sectors. The signed data program and H need not be positive. The optional full-generator reserve `hI+cN_C` is explicitly paid, including its prepared-sector phase and mean. Exact covariance cancellation belongs to the specified packet; H–program covariance and sampled-square fluctuations remain. Precision, preparation energy and timing bounds distinguish number-preserving errors from leakage. The final flag map has both unnormalized branches; it does not construct a physical reader, stopped clock or permanent record.

The following seven source roles are actually used for the abstract clock mechanism or its literal L4 application. `DEPENDENCIES.json` and `PARENT_BODY_RANGES.json` bind their exact canonical bytes and complete relied bodies; their narrower uses are listed here.

| [Full finite Gauss penalty](FINITE_GAUSS_PENALTY_RECOVERY_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md) | Literal full-space H, whole-term budget, scalar and coefficient sensitivity; no long-time initial-code recovery theorem is used during controls. |
| [Neutral preparation word](FIXED_NEUTRAL_RAY_PREPARATION_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md) | Exact finite target word, supplied clean active input and dirty/reference return. |
| [Coherent binary admission word](COHERENT_BINARY_K_ADMISSION_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md) | Clean work/flag contract, arbitrary active/reference input and both unnormalized outcomes. |
| [Fixed-background control](LITERAL_L4_FIXED_BACKGROUND_CONTROL_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md) | Full-H waveform certificate, effective data and complete recurrence duration; actual canonical `8f11d127…` at recorded regular PR9552. |
| [Existing Fourier-clock supplier](AUTONOMOUS_LOCAL_SUPPLIER_OF_ORIGINAL_ROTOR_RECORDS_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-09-30.md) | Characteristic, positive-smoothing and ordinary Fourier/Dyson machinery; no rotor, collision or resource-density result. Required clock estimates are rederived in this proof. |
| [Autonomous waveform bridge](LITERAL_L4_AUTONOMOUS_CLOCK_BRIDGE_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md) | Accepted full-phase waveform/application interface; actual canonical `8749f0bb…` at recorded regular PR9555. |
